author: Inside Edition
description: An American tourist who was killed in Germany three decades ago may finally get justice. Authorities in Germany say an 81-year-old man was arrested earlier this year for the sexual assault and murder of Amy Lopez, 24. They say she was visiting an ancient fortress in the city of Koblenz when the suspect lured her into a room of the building and attacked her. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Man Confesses To 1994 Killing Of American Tourist Amy Lopez In Germany: Reports

author: Inside Edition
description: Jared Bridegan was a Microsoft executive with a beautiful family. But in 2022, he was shot to death, ambushed after he left his car to remove a tire that had been placed in the road. Right away his wife pointed the finger at her husband's ex-wife and his ex-wife’s husband, and prosecutors ended up charging Shannah Gardner and her husband in a murder-for-hire plot. Now the trial is underway in Florida, with Bridegan's widow on the stand in tears. Both Gardner and her husband have pleaded not guilty.
title: Trial In Murder Of Microsoft Executive Jared Bridegan Begins In Florida

author: Inside Edition
description: The brother of Natalie Harp, a top aide to President Trump, is speaking out. Harp has found herself in the spotlight after Democratic United States Senator from Georgia, Jon Ossoff took a shot at the president, saying he was more interested in traveling with the 35-year-old Harp than doing his job. Natalie's brother, Preston Harp, says in an interview that the executive assistant has an "unhealthy" relationship with the president.
title: Natalie Harp's Brother Says Her Relationship With Trump Is 'Unhealthy'

author: Inside Edition
description: It's being called 'the Summer of the Shark,' but there's another creature danger at the beach: stingrays. The docile sea animals aren't usually aggressive, and only sting when they are stepped on or attacked. Yet, a number of swimmers in California have been stung by rays this summer. Their stings are painful and need to be treated, but are rarely fatal. Inside Edition's Jim Moret has the details.
title: Are We In 'The Summer Of The Sting Ray?'

author: Inside Edition
description: The late actress Hayden Panetierre was open about her volatile relationship with on-again,-off-again boyfriend Brian Hickerson. Hickerson was with the 36-year-old "Nashville" star when she died last weekend in Greenville, South Carolina. Now a woman who lived next door to Panetierre is coming forward to say fights between Panetierre and Hickerson were so loud she could hear them. She says it was so bad, the housing complex put up a sign telling Hickerson to stay away.
title: Hayden Panettiere's Neighbor Says She Witnessed Abuse

author: Inside Edition
description: They took the plunge into marital bliss, literally. Mike Missroon and Meghan Walsh Leapt arrived at their wedding ceremony in upstate New York after jumping out of a plane at 14,000 feet. They soared through the air above Seneca Lake, landing on the ground within seconds of each other. They then took their walk down the aisle. The couple say they met on their first tandem jump five years ago with Mike as the instructor. They now own and operate a skydiving school.
title: Skydiving Couple Arrives At Wedding Ceremony By Jumping Out Of Plane

author: Inside Edition
description: An Alabama mom who was shopping for kids' clothes got a creepy feeling when she felt something brush up against her leg. Allison Hoch says it was a man trying to film up her skirt. But Hoch tells Inside Edition's Alison Hall she turned the tables on the guy, and ended up catching him on video. She called 911 and was able to direct police to the suspect's location. The suspect was arrested a short time later at a restaurant.
title: Woman Turns Tables On Alleged Peeping Tom In Kids’ Clothing Store

author: Inside Edition
description: "What are you doing here?" That's the question one woman asked a stranger who showed up on her front porch after midnight. Police say the man followed Jerah Jorinscay home from a bar in Bellevue, Pennsylvania. But instead of cowering in fear, she let him have it. He was later arrested and charged with loitering, prowling at night and disorderly conduct. Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano spoke with Jorinscay about the disturbing incident.
title: Woman Confronts Alleged Stalker Who Cops Say Followed Her Home

title: @TheEvaPilgrim reflects on her first year as host of Inside Edition! #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: The surprises kept coming for the Zirbes family of Minneapolis. Not only did they find out they were expecting twins, they told CBS News tests would show they were unusual mono mono twins. That means the twins share the same amniotic sac and placenta. It can cause problems if not treated. Mom, Carrie, would go on bed rest while constantly being monitored. Doctors realized one baby was transfusing blood from the other, who had an enlarged heart. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Rare Mono Mono Twins Celebrate 1st Birthday After Tumultuous Year
